hints.title: Subarray Prefix Reset
hints.text: Finding the contiguous subarray with the largest sum does not require inspecting every pair of endpoints. If a running subarray sum becomes negative, continuing to extend it will only reduce the sum of any subsequent elements. Can you discard a negative running prefix as soon as it forms?

hints.title: Tracking Local and Global Extremes
hints.text: At each index, maintain two quantities: the maximum subarray sum that must end at the current index, and the overall maximum subarray sum discovered across the entire array so far.

hints.title: The Single-Pass Transition
hints.text: For each number x, either extend the previous subarray or start a new subarray beginning at x: current = max(x, current + x). Update the overall answer with best = max(best, current).

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: length of nums array (1 <= N <= 10^5)
complexity.notes: Single linear pass tracking running maximum with constant auxiliary memory.
